patterns.component_pattern: All UI components use forwardRef, TypeScript interfaces with JSDoc comments, and include inline usage examples in code
patterns.documentation_pattern: Existing docs use markdown in docs/ folder with clear structure (see docs/ROUTES.md)
patterns.prop_documentation: Props are documented inline with /** */ JSDoc comments describing their purpose
patterns.styling_pattern: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support, custom color tokens (primary, secondary), responsive design
patterns.variant_pattern: Components support multiple variants (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, danger) and sizes (sm, md, lg)

existing_implementations.description: Components already have inline JSDoc with basic examples but lack comprehensive external documentation
relevant_files: components/ui/button.tsx - Has ButtonProps interface with JSDoc, variantStyles, sizeStyles
components/ui/card.tsx - Card with sub-components (CardHeader, CardFooter, CardContent)
components/ui/input.tsx - Input and Textarea with label, error, helperText support
components/ui/modal.tsx - Modal with ConfirmModal variant, portal rendering
docs/ROUTES.md - Example of documentation style to follow

colors.red: red-400 through red-900 (for errors and danger states)

sizes.button: sm: px-3 py-1.5, md: px-4 py-2, lg: px-6 py-3
sizes.text: sm: text-sm, base: text-base, lg: text-lg

design_tokens.dark_mode: All components support dark mode with dark: prefix variants
